role: PlanetryVelocity: chat, presence, network commands, teleports and PlanetryItems grants; PlanetryVelocity-Backend is its authenticated Paper companion.
platform: Proxy JAR for Velocity; backend JAR for Paper/Purpur26.1.2 Java25. Single proxy network only.
compatibility: Proxy retains Java17 bytecode and Velocity3.1.1 API; CI also covers3.4.0/Java21 and4.2.0/Java25. Backend compiles against Paper26.1.2.build.74-stable. Stable proxy ID networkchat retains existing settings; backend renamed PlanetryVelocity-Backend copies absent config from NetworkChatBridge without overwriting/deleting legacy data.
integration: Existing signed-chat requirements, permissions, chat/teleport channels and configuration remain. Optional PAPIProxyBridge/SignedVelocity retain their existing roles. /pitems give and /planetryitems give require proxy planetry.admin.items, route only online visible players, and insert on recipient current backend through matching PlanetryItems. Target catalog supplies asynchronous prefix completions; quantities1..2304. Local non-give subcommands forward to sender backend; backend console remains local. Definitions continue to load per backend from recursive plugins/PlanetryItems/items/; no distribution. items.properties controls restart-only item route settings; teleport.properties shared-secret/server allowlist apply independently of teleport enablement. Backend items-enabled kill switch and bounded item-replay-cache-size. Separate HMAC planetry:items protocol with strict expiry, source/session/result correlation and no arbitrary command execution. Durable grant reservations precede inventory mutation and survive restart; capacity/corruption fail closed. No automatic retries; timeout means unconfirmed and requires checking inventory. Installed disabled/incompatible/unready Inventory Sync denies item mutation. Missing Items does not disable teleports. Releases contain PlanetryVelocity-VERSION.jar and PlanetryVelocity-Backend-VERSION.jar with SHA256SUMS. No live installation.
validation: Java25 mvn -B -ntp -Ppaper clean verify dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=target/test-classpath.txt; Python scripts/bridge-smoke.py with backend JAR, optionally --items-jar matched actual Items JAR. scripts/smoke.py JAVA PROXY_JAR VELOCITY_VERSION exercises real proxy console. CI retains API matrix and exact tested artifacts. Protocol, proxy and backend regression tests plus real Paper controlled player/API probes do not prove real-client command trees, actual cross-backend transport, Purpur or production integrations. Stage two clients/backends and actual plugin/resource-pack set. See docs/ACCEPTANCE.md.
